summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 49 of CipherBox (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation unwrap consolidation, plus REQ-6 batch/drag parity added mid-session), then run the full PR-QA pipeline (simplify, security-review, security:review, CodeRabbit CLI, push, PR, resolve CodeRabbit GitHub review) and kick off a CI e2e run.
summary.outcome: PR #509 was created and all pre-PR QA passed. CI e2e failures revealed a regression (mid-double-click layout shift from selection bar gating) and a deeper architectural gap (shared subfolder write keys not distributed + IPNS cache per-user keying blocking decentralized moves), which were fixed by distributing folder-ipns/file-ipns write keys to recipients and replacing the share-authorization-gated IPNS publish model with a signature-gated, name-keyed model; the final CI run was still in progress at session end.

repo: Cross-package dist staleness: web tsc checks the built SDK dist, not source — must run `pnpm build` in the SDK package before web typecheck after any public API changes, or web tsc silently uses stale types.

The private vault gates SelectionActionBar on `selectedIds.size > 1`; gating on `size > 0` causes a mid-double-click layout shift because the first click of a dblclick pops the bar in and shifts rows, so the second click misses the row and navigation silently dies.

`SharedFolderRow` renders folder names with a trailing `/` in the DOM, so `getFolderItemNames()` returned `'name/'`; established test convention is slash-tolerant `.includes()`, not exact `.toContain(bareName)`.

`collectChildKeys` (key-wrapping.ts) only emits `folder`/`file` (read) keys for descendants — never `folder-ipns`/`file-ipns` write keys — even on write shares, so every owner-created subfolder/file in the subtree was read-only to the recipient.

`CHILD_KEY_TYPES` in `apps/api/src/shares/types.ts` was missing `folder-ipns` — adding it propagates to both `@IsIn` validation and the `@ApiProperty enum` in `ChildKeyDto` and triggers a regenerated API client.

`folder_ipns` was keyed `@Unique(['userId', 'ipnsName'])` — a per-user design causing non-owner publishes to fork duplicate rows. `resolveRecord` used `findOne({ where: { ipnsName } })` with no user filter and no ordering, so resolution returned an arbitrary row when two existed.

The TEE republishes the owner's enrolled `folder_ipns` row to the DHT every 6h, overwriting any non-owner DHT updates — so key possession alone is not sufficient for durable writes without also updating the canonical DB row.

The `ipns` package (already a dep of `@cipherbox/core`) exports `validate(publicKey, marshalledRecord)` for Ed25519 SignatureV2 verification, and `@cipherbox/crypto` was the right home for the crypto helpers since the API already depends on it.

CodeRabbit CLI (`--agent`) produces structured JSON findings; its GitHub review posts nitpicks in the review body (not inline threads), so `/resolve-pr-reviews` sees 0 unresolved threads — address body nitpicks manually.
GSD executors may report `commit_failed` even when the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log` rather than trusting the executor's commit status output.
Migrations are glob-loaded from the migrations dir — adding a new file is sufficient; no explicit registration needed.
The `varchar(12)` column for share key types accommodates `folder-ipns` (11 chars) without a schema migration for column width.

code.finding: Private vault gates SelectionActionBar on `selectedIds.size > 1` — the critical pattern that prevents mid-dblclick layout shift. SharedFileBrowser incorrectly used `size > 0` initially.
`findActiveWriteShare` was an exact-`ipnsName` match against only the top-level Share row — no mechanism to authorize a recipient publishing a descendant ipnsName, causing forks.

CipherBox saves IPNS records to the DB first before the DHT ('so resolve always has a fallback'), making the DB the source of truth for resolution — why key possession alone is insufficient without server authorization.
`@Unique(['userId', 'ipnsName'])` was the per-user keying constraint, changed to `@Unique(['ipnsName'])` for the decentralized model.

`enumerateSharedSubtree` writability check requires a per-subfolder `share_keys` row with `keyType: 'folder-ipns'`; without it the subfolder renders as aria-disabled 'Read-only folder' in the move dialog.
`getFolderItemNames()` returned `'name/'` because `SharedFolderRow` appends a trailing `/` to folder names. Fixed by stripping trailing `/` in the page object.
`CHILD_KEY_TYPES` controls both `@IsIn` validation and `@ApiProperty enum` for `ChildKeyDto` — the single source of truth for which key types the API accepts as child keys on share creation.
`enumerateSharedSubtree` DFS needed per-iteration `folderKey.fill(0)` in a try/finally to avoid plaintext AES folder keys remaining live in heap across the entire DFS traversal.

workflow: Sequential wave execution (no worktrees) is more reliable for long AFK runs than parallel-worktree execution — avoids cwd-drift, merge-base footguns, and concurrent test RAM contention.
When disabling commit signing for an AFK session (`git config --local commit.gpgsign false`), flag immediately that a signed rebase is required before merge if the repo enforces signatures on PRs.

Deleting source files in one commit (parser deletion) before the replacement is committed leaves an intermediate non-building state — structure such changes so deletion and replacement land atomically.
Security reviews should be run after major architectural changes (not just once pre-PR) — the decentralized IPNS model needed a second review that caught the replay/rollback hole.

When a CI e2e test fails with a 'folder not found' or navigation assertion error in the shared browser, check `SharedFolderRow` first — it's the primary interaction surface and was modified heavily for DnD.
The `/resolve-pr-reviews` skill queries GraphQL `reviewThreads` and reports 0 threads when CodeRabbit uses review-body format — manually extract and apply body nitpicks in that case.
The `ipns` library's `validate()` enforces record EOL (expiry) automatically — no manual EOL check needed in the verify helper.
Anti-rollback sequence checking must use the record's embedded (signature-verified) sequence number, not the CAS field (which is optional and not always present).

friction: GSD executor commit helper reported `commit_failed` on multiple plans even when commits landed successfully — required manual `git log` verification after each wave.
Web package has no `typecheck` script; had to use `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web exec tsc -b` instead of a standard `pnpm typecheck` command.
CodeRabbit GitHub review posts all findings in the review body as nitpicks with 0 inline threads — `/resolve-pr-reviews` reported nothing to resolve, requiring manual extraction and application.
JSX comment inside a `{cond && (...)}` expression caused TS1005 parse error — had to merge the comment into the outer JSX comment block.
TS2352/TS2493 in batch test mock: `(c[1] as { itemId: string })` failed because the mock call tuple is typed as `[]`, requiring `(c as unknown as [string, { itemId: string }])[1].itemId`.
CodeRabbit false positive on `setError` assertion: suggested `not.toHaveBeenCalled()` but `runWrite` legitimately calls `setError(null)` on entry to clear prior errors — had to revert and document.

Parser file deletion landed in commit A (client key distribution) while the replacement `@cipherbox/crypto` helpers landed in commit B — leaving an intermediate commit where the API won't build in isolation.

The `extractPublicKeyFromIPNSRecord` function returns `undefined` synchronously for identity-key records (not a rejected promise), causing a `.catch` handler in `parseIpnsRecord` to never fire — required a sync undefined guard.
The pre-existing `writable-shares.spec.ts` passing on main masked the regression until CI ran — unit tests couldn't catch a Playwright dblclick coordinate-shift failure.
open_items: Branch commits are unsigned (signer disabled for AFK session) — needs a signed rebase before merge since the repo enforces signed commits on PRs.
Live e2e UAT for `shared-folder-move.spec.ts` is deferred to main-push (requires local docker stack with two accounts); the test is authored and type-checked but gated on CI infrastructure.
Third CI e2e run (after IPNS model + write-key distribution commits) was not yet dispatched at session end — needs to be confirmed green before merge.

Descendant move-cycle guard is UI-enforced (dialog disables descendants via parentId) + SDK self-move enforced (throws on same itemId), but there is no authoritative SDK subtree check — documented in PR as proportionate given the actor already holds write keys.

Revocation under the new decentralized IPNS model now requires IPNS key rotation + re-share rather than server-side row deletion — the security/UX implications of this tradeoff are documented but not yet surfaced in user-facing revoke flows.
3 pre-existing `integration.test.ts` SDK failures (need local docker API stack) — not regressions but they fail on every CI run without the docker environment.
`useMultiSelect` extraction (shared + private vault selection state) was identified as a simplification opportunity but deferred as cross-boundary scope creep beyond phase 49.
Batch key-refetch per item in `batchMoveItemsHandler` (fetches keys for each file individually rather than in bulk) noted as a performance follow-up — parity-acceptable for v1.

Database migration `1749300000000-IpnsCacheKeyedByName.ts` deduplicates `folder_ipns` rows by highest sequence and swaps the unique constraint — needs to be run and verified against staging before merge.
